file_roles.evidence: check_wsrep_max_ws_rows() moved out of ha_write_row/ha_update_row/ha_delete_row into binlog_log_row after logging, so rows not written to the binlog (ALTER temp table copies) no longer count.

rationale: ALTER copies rows into a temp table and wrongly counted them against wsrep_max_ws_rows, failing on one node only. The diff changes where the counter is incremented so only binlogged rows count.
